title: Add a Python dependency with uv
summary: Use `uv add` to install a package and add it to your project's dependencies in `pyproject.toml`. This ensures the package is available in your project environment.

steps.explain: Replace <PACKAGE> with the name of the Python package you want to install and add to your project.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the Python package to add.
